edges.subject: CTSD
edges.quote: mutations in cathepsin-F have been identified as the causative gene for autosomal recessive Kufs disease type B

edges.subject: Kufs disease type B
edges.quote: The magnetic resonance imaging findings were consistent with those demonstrated in adult neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis: diffuse cortical atrophy, mild hyperintensity and reduction of the deep white matter on T2-weighted images.

edges.subject: Kufs disease type B
edges.quote: Kufs disease type B (also termed CLN13), an adult-onset form of neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis (NCL)
